verdict.rationale: Claude Code explicitly supports running long-running tasks in the cloud/browser with no local setup, checking back later, working on remote repos, and running multiple tasks in parallel, plus mobile/web kickoff with teleport back to terminal. This directly matches delegating longer-running tasks to an isolated cloud environment. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the cloud sandbox isolation/reliability and more detail on resource limits or failure modes for these cloud sessions.
